text:
emma: Quick heads up — CI perf-suite flagged a p99 regression on the canary after the recent runtime merge (kernel-selector heuristic). ~25% p99 increase on short sequences (<=64). Can we pause the A/B rollout? https://ci.internal/redwood/12345

raj: Can you drop the perf numbers here? If it's the selector change we should bisect the merge commits.

ci-bot: CI: perf-suite/latency (canary) failed: p99 +25% on seq<=64. Full report: https://ci.internal/artifacts/12345

emma: Perf excerpt: 
```
p99_latency: baseline 18.2ms -> canary 22.8ms (+25.3%)
workload: chat-short (seq<=64)
kernel_selector: prefer 'opt-v3' for attention_small (changed in last merge)
batching: autotuner unchanged
kv_cache_hit_rate: 98.7% (no change)
```

sophia: I grabbed a perf trace from a canary pod. Hot path shows a big jump in memcpy inside the attention kernel after the opt-v3 codepath. Short snippet from perf-top: 
```
memcpy  32.4%  attention_opt_v3
matmul  28.1%  attention_common
overhead 12.3% scheduling
```

mike: If memcpy is the regression vector, reverting the selector heuristic (or at least pinning to the previous kernel) might be the fastest mitigation. Can we gate the rest of the rollout and roll back only that change?

emma: Agree. Requesting a pause of the A/B rollout at current 40% and pin new sessions to the previous kernel. @deploy-bot please hold rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployment paused for rollout id r-2026-03-18-009. Canary traffic frozen at 40%.

olga: I'll run a git-bisect across the last 6 commits touching runtime/kernel_selector. Starting now.

jordan: We should also add an SLO gate to the canary checks: run a short-seq synthetic load (seq<=64) and abort rollout if p99 delta > 10% sustained for 10m. Also add this as a quick CI perf job.

sophia: I can open a PR to add the synthetic short-seq job to the canary pipeline and perf CI. Low sample count (~500) so it runs fast.

raj: Thanks — keep the thread updated with bisect. If revert is needed, coordinate with release window and note the planned revert PR.

olga: Bisect complete: culprit is commit abcdef1 — changed alignment padding in opt-v3 attention kernel hint. Reverting that single change restores p99 to baseline in local repro.

emma: Excellent. Olga, please prepare the revert PR with before/after perf numbers and request expedited review. We'll keep rollout paused until merge + perf CI green.

ci-bot: perf-suite compare (baseline vs revert-pr): p99 delta -0.5% (within noise). CI: running integration and smoke.

mike: Nice find — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

emma: Summary: rollout is paused, revert PR in flight, synthetic short-seq SLO gate PR being opened. We'll unpause only after CI perf checks are green and canary synthetic p99 is within 10% of baseline. Thanks all.
